evals.prompt: 给我的博客做一个赛博朋克风格的登录页，深色、霓虹紫青配色，背景要有动效，左边放品牌介绍。
evals.expected_output: A dark split-layout AuthTemplate is created through the MCP tools, linted without warnings, and returned with preview links; it is not activated without confirmation.
expectations: auth-ui__get_design_guide is called before writing the spec
theme.layout is split or split-reverse and the brand copy is in slots.aside
colorScheme is dark and text, muted, surface, field and border are all set
exactly one motion.ambient effect is chosen from the guide's keywords
auth-ui__lint_design runs before auth-ui__create_design and its warnings are fixed
auth-ui__preview_design links are given to the user
auth-ui__activate_design is not called without the user's confirmation

evals.prompt: 把现在启用的登录设计主色改成 #e11d48，其他保持不变。
evals.expected_output: The active design is read with get_design and updated with its full spec and version; only theme.primary changes and the user is told the change is live.
expectations: auth-ui__get_design is called and its version is passed to auth-ui__update_design
the update sends the complete spec with only theme.primary changed
the user is told that editing the active design changes the live login immediately

evals.prompt: 登录页加一段脚本，提交登录时把按钮变成彩虹色，再把用户名输入框的 name 改成 email。
evals.expected_output: The visual effect is added through code.js or code.css with the AuthUI API, and the request to rename the form field is declined because Halo reads form fields.
expectations: the submit effect uses AuthUI.on('submit') or CSS, not inline event handlers in slots
the form field name is not changed and the user is told why
the user is told code.js does not run in previews and must be checked on the live site
